content:
MANUU Law School MANUU Hyderabad successfully conducted the Preliminary and Quarter-Final Rounds of the 1st International Client Counselling Competition 2026 on August 22nd. 

As the Student Co-Convener, this journey has been a truly enriching experience filled with coordination, teamwork, challenges and countless learnings. Grateful to the entire Client Counselling Committee, Technical Team, Court Masters, Clients and Volunteers for their dedication and support.

The online rounds are complete, and now we look forward to welcoming the four qualified teams for the Offline Semi-Final and Grand Finale on September 20, 2026.

One phase completed. The final stage awaits! ⚖️✨
